resources.string: Google TV didn’t take the saved PIN. Enter it on the keypad; Hearth won’t type it again until it’s saved anew.
Hearth couldn’t finish entering the PIN. Enter it on the keypad.
Someone at the TV wants to open your profile. Allow it, and Hearth enters your Google TV PIN.
Someone at %1$s wants to open this profile. Answer from the notification on your phone (Allow or Deny). The request ends by itself after 2 minutes.
Asked %1$s on their phone. The PIN can still be entered here.
This phone will be asked before anyone opens your Google TV profile.
